'''Get the Legendary Pokémon!''' (Japanese: '''伝説のポケモンを手に入れろ!''' ''Get the Legendary Pokémon!'') is the fourth chapter of the [[Pocket Monsters BW: The Heroes of Fire and Thunder]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Alder]] takes Shin to [[Relic Castle]] to find the [[Light Stone]], then betrays him and claims it for himself.
* {{OBP|Shin|FAT}} defeats Alder's {{p|Volcarona}} and he reveals it was all part of a plan of [[N]]'s for him to be accepted as a Hero by the Light Stone.
* Shin becomes the Hero of Fire and flies off to confront N.
